components.name: Skill orchestration and run-state guards
components.job: sequence the supported ten-step audit and enforce run identity
components.rationale: This is the supported entry contract, not an experimental reader.
components.change_gate: replacement must preserve run-state, bounds, and custody

components.name: Conversation capture and processing view
components.job: preserve complete available prose and create a bounded processing view
components.rationale: Authoritative source custody is constitutional; system/tool/file payloads are outside the capture contract.
components.change_gate: broader capture needs explicit privacy and authority design

components.name: Live extraction, ConversationContext, and IR
components.job: interpret one decision situation and normalize turns/context
components.rationale: Required live semantic input, but bounded extraction is not full conversation comprehension.
components.change_gate: semantic reliability must be evaluated separately

components.name: Four pressure lanes
components.job: generate tendency, model-companion, frame, and structural pressure
components.rationale: This is the live experimental core retained by the R4 closeout.
components.change_gate: real-user usefulness and unique-value evidence

components.name: Mental-model registry, retrieval, and embeddings
components.job: supply canonical model identity and candidate retrieval
components.rationale: Canonical registry and deterministic retrieval are live; embeddings are bounded infrastructure, not semantic proof.
components.change_gate: registry or retrieval changes require identity and recall evidence

components.name: Constitutional graph survival, active set, and reserve
components.job: preserve graph pressure before probabilistic verification
components.rationale: Directly implements Constitution rule 17 and protects deterministic pressure from probabilistic re-domestication.
components.change_gate: any replacement must prove graph survival and missingness

components.name: Reconsideration and apply/reject/park ledger
components.job: force explicit treatment of pressure and persist disposition
components.rationale: Constitutional friction and decision custody exist, while same-context self-justification remains a known limitation.
components.change_gate: fresh-context or human evaluation before stronger semantic claims

components.name: Revised answer, memo, archive, agent result, and receipt
components.job: record the original/revised process and durable run artifacts
components.rationale: The record proves process custody, not decision wisdom.
components.change_gate: artifact changes require replay and missingness compatibility

components.name: Provider, usage, cost, privacy, and run-health custody
components.job: bound calls and preserve mechanical execution evidence
components.rationale: Deterministic custody is constitutional infrastructure and never a quality badge.
components.change_gate: provider changes require separate operator validation

components.name: Observatory read-only workspace
components.job: inspect archived and active run projections
components.rationale: Useful inspection surface; it reads artifacts and does not authorize or mutate decisions.
components.change_gate: write behavior requires separate constitutional review

components.name: Decision Trail and portable completed-run reports
components.job: project checked-in-safe run artifacts into inspectable summaries
components.rationale: Deterministic and provisional fields are useful when missingness and authority remain explicit.
components.change_gate: human-reviewed semantic coverage before stronger claims

components.name: Product Delta evaluation
components.job: compare completed artifacts and package specialist review
components.rationale: It evaluates artifacts and does not alter live output.
components.change_gate: human usefulness evidence before product promotion

components.name: Decision Work brief, triage, resolver, and sidecar
components.job: package supplied semantic reads for operator inspection and explicit bounded writes
components.rationale: The sidecar packages meaning; it does not reliably generate arbitrary-run meaning.
components.change_gate: human-reviewed semantic supplier and action-safety proof

components.name: Portable Markdown and agent-memory projections
components.job: render bounded inspectable artifacts outside the browser
components.rationale: Portability is useful when locators, missingness, and non-authorization are retained.
components.change_gate: private-source exposure review

components.name: Default-off post-archive pressure and Decision Work hooks
components.job: attach optional artifacts only when explicitly enabled
components.rationale: Default-off behavior prevents optional semantics from masquerading as ordinary runtime.
components.change_gate: automatic enablement requires founder authorization and semantic evidence

components.name: Mental Model Teacher
components.job: teach and inspect mental-model relationships
components.rationale: The founder-selected Atlas job now has a source-bound local visual tracer bullet, but founder visual acceptance, native screen-reader review, publication rights, and real-user usefulness evidence remain pending.
components.change_gate: founder acceptance of the Phase 1 visual truth gate, source-rights review, and a separately authorized real-user evidence plan

components.name: Arbitrary-run Decision Work semantic generation
components.job: produce trustworthy semantic reads for completed conversations
components.rationale: Schemas, queues, and supplied-read intake do not prove a general semantic reader.
components.change_gate: materially different architecture plus protected source-first human evaluation

components.name: R4 residual and separated-surface readers
components.job: experimental unresolved-matter and reopen-condition interpretation
components.rationale: A2 proved companions persist under separation; incremental extension and integration are stopped.
components.change_gate: explicit founder reversal and materially different architecture, not prompt tuning

components.name: R4 sources, targets, requests, responses, runners, and closeouts
components.job: preserve reproducible negative and mixed scientific evidence
components.rationale: Custody and corpus remain valuable even though the reader is retired.
components.change_gate: never feed live product without separate authorization

components.name: R3 and legacy reasoning-process readers
components.job: historical exploration of role, stance, shard, and reasoning-process semantics
components.rationale: They explain learning history but do not define current product semantics.
components.change_gate: new causal question and founder authorization

components.name: Evaluation, replay, fake transport, and custody harnesses
components.job: validate experiments and preserve deterministic evidence
components.rationale: Strong custody machinery should be preserved without becoming product semantics.
components.change_gate: case-specific authorization for future research

components.name: Legacy development scripts, probes, and pre-PR utilities
components.job: support historical local analysis and construction
components.rationale: File existence is not support; removal needs a separate dependency audit.
components.change_gate: usage inventory before isolation or deletion

components.name: Fixtures and test-only adapters
components.job: exercise contracts without asserting ordinary reachability
components.rationale: Tests prove bounded behavior, not live product integration.
components.change_gate: none; retain with owning subsystem

components.name: Mental-model relationship graph
components.job: supply deterministic neighborhood and structural relationships
components.rationale: Graph survival is live; graph recall is not semantic relevance proof.
components.change_gate: relationship changes require graph-survival and identity validation

components.name: Real-user usefulness and market evidence
components.job: show that pressure, later understanding, or inspection helps people
components.rationale: Mechanical and simulated evidence cannot establish usefulness or adoption.
components.change_gate: bounded human study with explicit falsifier and privacy scope
